svg.text: CONTROL VALVE, FO / FC = FAIL OPEN / CLOSED
E-201/202/203 COOLING TOWER CELLS, INDUCED DRAFT, 113 m³/h EACH
P-212/213/214 CELL FANS, 30 kW, SINGLE SPEED
P-215…218 CW PUMPS, 3 + 1 SPARE, 119 m³/h, 345 kPa g
S-281 SIDE-STREAM FILTER, 15 m³/h; P-219 BACKWASH PUMP
D-283 ACID, D-284 NaOCl, D-285 BIOCIDE DAY TANKS
LINE NUMBERS: DNsize-SERVICE-2nn. CWR / CWS COOLING
WATER RETURN / SUPPLY, MU MAKE-UP, BD BLOWDOWN,
DR DRAIN, CH CHEMICAL. SIZES PRELIMINARY (TBC).
1. ALTERNATIVE VERSION (EPC STANDARD) OF THE SCREEN P&ID CWT-V1-PID-001 REV 0. THE SCREEN DRAWING STAYS THE REFERENCE FOR THE DCS, DECKS AND EXERCISES.
2. DESIGN CASE FROM THE SIMULATOR MODEL: 340 m³/h, 49.2 → 32.3 °C, WET BULB 27 °C, 6.62 MW; MAKE-UP 11.2, EVAPORATION 8.4, BLOWDOWN 2.7 m³/h, 4 CYCLES.
3. EVERY FIELD TRANSMITTER IS INDICATED IN THE DCS WITH THE SAME LOOP NUMBER (TT-201 → TI-201, PT-202 → PI-202 ...). PT C/W ROOT AND TEST VALVES (TYP., NOT SHOWN).
4. HS-201…HS-204 MOTOR-OPERATED (ABOUT 20 s STROKE). OTHER HS VALVES HAND-OPERATED. FANS SINGLE SPEED, NO VSD.
5. TI-203 IS THE KEY USER'S PROCESS OUTLET, SIGNAL FROM THE USERS' DCS. USERS DRAWN AS A BATTERY LIMIT.
6. RETURN-PATH PERMISSIVE (A RISER OR HS-204 ≥ 20 % OPEN) IS DISPLAYED BUT NOT IN THE START LOGIC: OPEN QUERY (C&E CWT-V1-IN-CE-001).
7. HS-205 IS DRAWN AS A HAND VALVE ON THE SCREEN P&ID; THE ESD CLOSES IT, SO IT IS SHOWN HERE WITH AN ACTUATOR (TBC).
8. LSLL-201 READS LT-201 AS IN THE SIMULATOR (SHARED WITH LIC-201). A SEPARATE LSLL-201B IS RECOMMENDED (HAZOP R12, LOPA L2).
9. ACID TANK LEVEL IS LI-201 ON THE SCREEN P&ID; RENUMBERED LT/LI-283 HERE SO LOOP 201 IS UNIQUE.
10. BUNDS FOR D-283/284/285 AND DEDICATED DELIVERY COUPLINGS: HOLD (HAZID H06, HAZOP R20).
11. RELIEF ON S-281 AND THERMAL RELIEF AT THE USERS: HOLD, VENDOR / USERS TO CONFIRM (SAFETY LAYERS).
INTERLOCK SCHEDULE (SIS-201, DE-ENERGISE TO TRIP, ALL LATCHED)
STOP PUMPS, FANS, P-201/219/220/221; CLOSE HS-205
COOLING WATER TOWER VER 1 · OTS · ISSUED FOR TEACHING
